title: Existence of normalized ordinary finite pullback
statement: theorem ordinaryFinitePull_exists (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) : ∃ e : pull F (constantMap F A) ⋙ change (quotient J' A I n) ≅ change (quotient J A I n) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))), ∀ M : Mod (constant J A), pullInsertion F (constantMap F A) M ≫ insertion (quotient J' A I n) ((pull F (constantMap F A)).obj M) ≫ (underlying (finite J' A I n)).map (e.hom.app M) = L.map (insertion (quotient J A I n) M) ≫ pullInsertion F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))) ((change (quotient J A I n)).obj M)

proof.text: Construct the comparison by transporting the finite quotient tensor comparison through the inverse-image module lift. The insertion equation follows on pure tensors and extends by the sheafified tensor universal property.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFinitePull_exists
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : pull F (constantMap F A) ⋙ change (quotient J' A I n) ≅
        change (quotient J A I n) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))),
      ∀ M : Mod (constant J A),
        pullInsertion F (constantMap F A) M ≫
            insertion (quotient J' A I n) ((pull F (constantMap F A)).obj M) ≫
            (underlying (finite J' A I n)).map (e.hom.app M) =
          L.map (insertion (quotient J A I n) M) ≫
            pullInsertion F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))
              ((change (quotient J A I n)).obj M)
